entry.source: Lessons round (23 October 2026). The courtyard's thousands of leaves took 7 minutes to build one object at a time and about 10 s built in bulk (japanese-courtyard story log 7, measured); the finished courtyard holds 89 objects (log 13); the mine's builder notes say one object per material group, not one per shape. Set well above 89 and far below thousands: object count, not triangles, slows scripts, saving and export

entry.unit: metres from the nearest view camera, metres across, share of a view's rays that go below the horizon and hit nothing
entry.source: Lessons round: the mine (village_and_sky, ground_and_yard known flaws: empty sky above a dark slab, the ground's square edge in view) and the courtyard (story log 9: hazy backdrop hills blocked the sun until they stopped casting shadows). Any ray below the horizon that hits nothing means the view sees past the edge of the ground; far and large are starting points

entry.unit: share of the ground points a view sees that are shadowed from the sun
entry.source: Lessons round: courtyard story log 9 (the sun did nothing: a 4 m hall with the sun low behind it shadowed about 25 m of garden, and hazy hills blocked the sun too; the scene looked flat and the materials were blamed). Shadow length is height / tan(sun height). More than half the seen ground in shadow is a reason to look
